description: A PRICING AND HEALTH probe on the bytecode that is actually deployed, and nothing else. Four iterations at the campaign fraction with NOTHING observing them - no flight recorder, no GC log - because a price is only honest if it is measured on the stack that will be run, by a clock carrying nothing the arm will not pay (arm_cost.py excludes every profiled run for that reason). IT EXISTS BECAUSE NO ARM HAS EVER EXECUTED THIS CONTROLER. The deployed classes now carry citysim.PtCrowdingScoring and PtCrowdingConfigGroup (crowding disutility reaching MATSim scoring for the first time - MATSim core scores no crowding term at all), an EscortCoherenceListener that stops proposing at the innovation cutoff, a mode-aware GenericRouteTeleporter refusal and a NetworkDirectWalkPtRouter request counter (9.158, 9.159). Every one of the five arms behind arm_cost.py's 22.2 h quote for the depth arm predates all of it: observed_arms() filters on FRACTION and PROFILED and on nothing else, so it warns loudly about a stale RUN and says nothing about a stale BUILD, and the quote today prices a stack that no longer exists. Two error directions that do not cancel: the crowding scorer adds handlers to PersonEntersVehicleEvent and PersonLeavesVehicleEvent, the two highest-volume classes in a run producing 635,483 departures a median iteration, inside an events pipeline already measured at its knee (1 thread saturated, 2 is +44.5% slower, 4 and 12 equal); against that, the innovation-off tail is worth roughly 14 minutes the flat 260 s model does not credit. The upward risk is the larger and it is unquantified. THE SECOND THING IT SETTLES IS WHETHER THE STACK RUNS AT ALL: the two most recent runs on disk, aborted_20260908T231109_4it_1pct and aborted_20260908T232051_4it_1pct, both DIED AT ITERATION 0 - one on TransitAgentTriesToTeleportException, one at PersonPrepareForSim - and both were 1% probes of the network access/egress basis this overlay does NOT set. This one runs at the shipped beeline basis, the state every arm since F4 has run. THE PRECEDENT IT ANSWERS TO: at 9.153 the F30 arm ran 45% over the price read from the arm before it, on a stack differing by one line. COST: quoted 46 min against a recent spread of 37-45 min at this fraction, which is 2.3% of the 32 h ceiling approved for the depth arm it precedes. READ IT FOR TWO THINGS AND NOTHING ELSE - the recurring iteration wall time, and whether four iterations complete. It is four iterations at 25%: its mode shares are a reading of a model that has not begun to relax (the choice set does not close until about iteration 74) and MUST NOT be quoted as a share, a count, a fit or a deviation for any mode. IT OPENS THE COMPARABILITY FAMILY, and that is a correction to an earlier form of this sentence which said the family would open at the depth arm instead: a family opens at a LAUNCH or a REBUILD, and this is the first launch on this controler. F32-crowding-reaches-scoring runs from this stamp; the depth arm is its first ARM, not its first run.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: The declared sweep starts at 250 because that is the largest value MEASURED to be insufficient for convergence (DECISIONS.md 9.7), so the whole range describes candidate MODELLING runs. This overlay is not one: it prices an iteration on the deployed bytecode and asks whether four iterations complete at all, and four is the window that measurement needs (0 warms up, 1-3 compare). The value sits deliberately far below the range so that any output carrying it is obviously not a result - the same reasoning, and the same value, as f27_timing_probe_25pct (9.147), f30_profile_probe_25pct and f30_plain_probe_25pct (9.155). Nothing this run produces may be quoted as a share, a count, a fit or a deviation for any mode.
